{{Olympic water polo records and statistics sidebar|expanded=all}}
This is a list of top goalscorers in the women's Olympic [[water polo]] [[Water polo at the Summer Olympics|tournament]] since the inaugural official edition in [[Water polo at the 2000 Summer Olympics – Women's tournament|2000]].

==Overall top goalscorers==
As of 2016, eighteen female players have scored 20 or more goals at the Summer Olympics.

Last updated: 1 April 2021.
